title: Provenance
description: Metadata describing how the analysis data was collected, including timing information and details of each tool invocation.

collectionDuration.description: Total wall-clock time for the collection run, in milliseconds.

toolRuns.description: Ordered list of tool invocations that contributed to this collection.

ToolRun.description: Record of a single tool invocation during collection.

tool.description: Name or identifier of the tool that was executed (e.g. 'ts-morph-collector', 'eslint').

aspect.description: Which analysis aspect this tool served (e.g. 'structure', 'complexity', 'dependencies').

exitCode.description: Process exit code returned by the tool. 0 indicates success.

duration.description: Wall-clock time for this tool run, in milliseconds.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings emitted by the tool during execution.
